Input sees every platform event before game handling
Logical and drawable sizes are not interchangeable
Do not present a bound offscreen target
Content pipeline does not require runtime devices
The renderer choice latches on the first successful device
SDL stays at its declared native edges

links.label: CNA-BUG-119: The XNB type-reader registry is process-wide and unsynchronised, and every reader construction writes to it
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-150: StorageDevice::EnsureStorageRoot caches the process-wide storage root in unsynchronised statics
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-156: HttpNotificationChannel answers length-less, chunked and truncated pushes with 200 and reads request bodies of unbounded size
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-161: A handler that throws during HttpNotificationChannel::DispatchPendingNotificationsEXT discards every remaining notification of that batch
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-163: HttpNotificationChannel writes its reply with ::send flags 0, so a peer that aborts its connection mid-request can end the process with SIGPIPE
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-164: HttpNotificationChannel's listener reads listenSocket_ unsynchronised while Close resets it, and spins without backoff on a persistent accept error
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-182: Win32Dialogs file dialogs run modally inside Show* and invoke the callback before returning, contrary to the IPlatformDialogs timing contract
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-241: docs/devices-event-contract.md and docs/devices-thread-safety.md describe sensor behaviour the code no longer has
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-GAP-071: Only EasyGL leases its context to other threads: on every other renderer, graphics resources created on a loading thread have no CNA-level exclusion against the frame
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-PLAT-009: Android Compass and Motion: stopping waits at most five seconds for the sensor worker, after which the bridge is abandoned for good and a handler still running can outlive its owner
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-058: No dedicated test drives the production audio shutdown path (static destruction of the SDL3 device at exit with callbacks in flight): the teardown tests call DestroyMixer, and plan item AUD-15-016 is unchecked
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-099: Classic SDL_GPU CTests still fail in CNA's latest recorded runs (25 of 238); CNA's records name a cause for only four of them
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-184: Core's build files still carry dependencies its sources dropped: -lembind on Emscripten and a link probe that tolerates SDL3
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-192: metal-macos-ci.yml's push path filter names three CMake files that no longer exist and omits the files that now register the Metal tests
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-193: general-tests-ci.yml still allowlists EasyGL_GraphicsDevice_ReferenceStencil as a known failure after REMED-GFX-236 fixed it, so a regression of that test cannot turn the job red
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-199: Five CI workflows pin August 2026 sharp-runtime commits that lack components CNA's default closure requests (Xml.Serialization off Windows, Resources everywhere), so they stop at configure
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-202: In a multi-renderer build, non-default renderers' example CTests are registered but run under the default renderer
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-203: SdlGpu_2D_HeadlessDriver forces headless mode under the x11 video driver that the SDL_GPU constructor refuses for it
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-247: The EasyGL L7 policy and report justify zero tolerance with 'all 137 renderable assets' while the report's own fields record 140 captured, byte-identical assets
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-BUG-275: CnaTests sources call POSIX setenv and unsetenv without a platform guard, and the check that refused such calls is no longer registered
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-GAP-002: CNA::Logger serialises writes but not level changes, and a sink must not call back into the logger
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-GAP-059: In a MinGW-w64 cross tree CnaTests gets a Wine CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR only when the default renderer is DIRECTX9, DIRECTX11 or DIRECTX12
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-001: Matrix camera builders have no XNA oracle and no full-matrix value test
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-005: The XNA audio facade on CNA's own ALSA mixer is covered by seven facade tests plus the XACT category suite; the SoundEffect, instance, dynamic-instance, Cue, SoundBank and WaveBank suites run only on SDL3
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-006: Media paths without tests: the natural song end on SDL3_mixer, the failed visualization install, MediaLibrary accessors after Dispose and SavePicture's IOException
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-011: No test exercises PlatformSelection.cmake's reserved-identifier refusal paths
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-012: No CI workflow selects CNA_PLATFORM=WAYLAND, so the native Wayland backend's suites run only on a developer's machine
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-016: A plain ctest run of the tests preset is not a trustworthy result
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-019: ModuleLinkClosure_* link-closure gates report CTest SKIP in every Ninja tree, so no Ninja-preset run and no CI job ever evaluates them
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-020: The hand-written CnaPlatformTests filter misses TerminalPresenterThroughPlatformTest and eight other platform suites, so the platform CI cells never select them
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-051: No CI configuration builds diagnostics at STATS or FULL or enables CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR, so most Diagnostics tests and every Inspector test are never compiled in CI
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

links.label: CNA-VGAP-053: No CI workflow builds the C API library or runs its tests

links.label: CNA-VGAP-056: The checked-in shader bytecode headers of VULKAN, SDL_GPU and the Direct3D renderers come from generators that no CTest or workflow runs and that have no --check mode
links.in: section: Known issues in this area

BackToFront — the deepest sprite is drawn first, so a different sprite finishes on top. Real XNA 4.0 output, recorded as pixel-identical to CNA's DIRECTX9 renderer.
FrontToBack — here the sort is a no-op and the frame is byte-identical to Deferred . Real XNA 4.0 output, recorded as pixel-identical to CNA's DIRECTX9 renderer.

cards.title: What you’ll learn
cards.excerpt: ℹ What you’ll learn Configuring AlphaTestEffect , its AlphaFunction and ReferenceAlpha . Why cutout foliage wants alpha testing rather than alpha blending. Where vertex colour fits in. Before you start — Tutorial 32: Bas

The baseline scene — the default Greater test at the reference alpha keeps the two left regions and clips the rest. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA's DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel. That is a DIRECTX9 statement: i
Always — every fragment passes, so all four regions survive regardless of alpha. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
Never — every fragment is discarded, leaving only the clear colour. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
Less — the exact inverse of the baseline: only the low-alpha regions survive. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
LessEqual — adds the region sitting exactly at the reference alpha to what Less keeps. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
Equal — only the one region whose alpha is exactly the reference value survives. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
GreaterEqual — the usual cutout-foliage setting; keeps everything at or above the threshold. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
NotEqual — the complement of Equal : the single region at the reference alpha is the only one clipped. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.

links.in: section: Getting Started

links.in: section: Getting Started

links.in: section: Getting Started

stats.label: alpha.1 version string
stats.title: CNA_VERSION_STRING is still 0.1.0-alpha.1 at snapshot b0e97bb1; no newer tag exists. This site documents the development branch after the v0.1.0-alpha.1 tag.

stats.label: Commits since the alpha.1 tag
stats.title: 3,333 commits (945 first-parent, 65 merges) between tag v0.1.0-alpha.1 (1bb2145d, 20 Aug 2026) and snapshot b0e97bb1 (4 Oct 2026)

stats.label: Renderer identities
stats.title: 18 public identities over 14 implementation families; the five OpenGL ES, OpenGL 3.3 and WebGL identities share one EasyGL family. Unknown or unsupported names stop the CMake configure step.

stats.label: Platform implementations
stats.title: CNA_PLATFORM: SDL3 (default), X11, Wayland, Win32, Headless and POSIX Terminal. X11, Wayland and Win32 are native backends that do not use SDL; Win32 is offered for Windows targets and Terminal on POSIX hosts.

stats.label: Audio platform choices
stats.title: CNA_AUDIO_PLATFORM: SDL3, ALSA and Null. SDL3 and ALSA enable the XNA playback mixer (SOUND_ENABLED); Null is a deterministic device-level surface only.

stats.label: Static test definitions
stats.title: Across 852 CNA-owned C++ test sources (821 contain macros); vendored third_party sources excluded. 779 standalone renderer pixel programs are not counted. Definitions are not executed cases and no CTest total is published.

stats.label: XNA runtime members represented
stats.title: Representation only: every documented XNA 4.0 runtime member (331/331 types) has a declaration in CNA's public headers, measured by tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py. It does not claim behavioral parity.

stats.label: C++ sample ports complete
stats.title: External repository, pinned: cna-samples @ 5db32e6 (2026-10-03). 91 of the 153 entries of the SAMPLE-001 to SAMPLE-153 audit list are complete C++ ports; 8 relevant XNA 4.0 C# programs remain and 54 entries are not port targets (XNA 3.x or older, Silverlight, WinForms tools, VB.NET, C++, asset packs). The Racing Game Kit is a separate, additional port. Not a result for CNA snapshot b0e97bb1.

stats.label: Samples playable in the browser
stats.title: samples.libcna.com @ b3939de (2026-10-03): 90 playable C++ WebAssembly builds of the ported samples (one, PerformanceUtility, marked partial); each was run in Chrome when its port was completed.

stats.label: Original C# sample programs on CNA.NET
stats.title: cna-cs-samples @ 1e6d763 (2026-10-04): 83 Microsoft XNA 4.0 sample projects (84 programs) built from byte-identical upstream C# source run on CNA.NET on Linux, in headless Chromium and on the x86_64 Android emulator. Recorded in the CNA.NET campaign ledgers, not CI.

stats.label: CI workflow files
stats.title: Workflow files (26 jobs), not passing lanes. The Direct3D Windows lanes are manual; no workflow runs the XNA oracle corpus, a Wayland session or a C API library build.

known-issues/bugs/cna-bug-052.html.title: CNA-BUG-052: SongTypeReader and MediaLibraryIndex offer song formats (.opus, .aac, .wma) that no CNA-configured mixer decodes - CNA Known Issues
known-issues/bugs/cna-bug-052.html.description: Load<Song> resolves .opus, .aac and .wma files and the media library indexes .opus, but neither the vendored SDL3_mixer build nor CNA's ALSA mixer decodes them, so such songs load and then silently fail to play.

known-issues/bugs/cna-bug-076.html.title: CNA-BUG-076: Color::FromNonPremultiplied(int r, int g, int b, int a) multiplies in 32-bit int, so large arguments overflow (undefined behaviour) - CNA Known Issues
known-issues/bugs/cna-bug-076.html.description: CNA computes r * a / 255 in int; XNA 4.0 widens to 64-bit long before multiplying and clamps the result, so arguments whose product exceeds INT_MAX are defined in XNA and undefined in CNA.

known-issues/bugs/cna-bug-183.html.description: ResultTrampoline and EntryClickTrampoline invoke the application's std::function directly from SDL C callbacks, so an exception escaping it crosses SDL frames (undefined behaviour, typically std::terminate).

headings.text: 18 renderer identities, single or multi-renderer builds Shipped
EasyGL renderer — the most mature path Shipped
Direct3D 9 renderer — functional, and the pixel-exact XNA oracle target Shipped
Build-time Content Pipeline and the CNB format Shipped
PBR effects and skeletal animation Shipped
Pixel-exact verification against the real XNA runtime Shipped
A real Input, Audio, Net and Storage core Shipped
XNA API representation closed: 331 of 331 types, 3,627 of 3,627 members Shipped
Native platforms: X11, Wayland and Win32 Shipped
ALSA audio and optional FFmpeg Shipped
Compiled XNA effects on 14 renderer identities Shipped
Modern-graphics campaigns: SDL_GPU, WebGPU, Vulkan and Direct3D 11/12 Shipped
CNAEXT extensions Opt-in, not in CI
Diagnostics and Inspector Opt-in, not in CI
XNA 4.0 samples in C++, in the browser and in original C# Practically complete
Gamer Services, Guide, avatars and online sessions Linux-qualified
Save persistence on the web Shipped
Partial, and known to be partial
DIRECTX12 — no longer missing scissor, viewport, stencil and blend factor Partial
WebGPU — formerly no render targets at all Partial
Metal — a narrow 3D contract and no compiled effects Partial
Experimental C API — release gate "Not ready" Partial
Compiled effects beyond qualified builds Partial
ReflectiveReader for custom XNB types Partial
Media portability and codec coverage Platform-dependent
Deeper tests for Media, Storage and Canvas Open
Wayland, Android and oracle checks in CI Open
CNA.NET on Windows, macOS and iOS Future qualification
